units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 5:1">Pes. V, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 58a:1">58ᵃ</cite>) <he>בששה ומחצה</he> (Y. a. Bab. ed. <cite ref="B01375"><he>בשש</he></cite>) at six hours and a half (from sunrise). Y. ib. IV, beg. 30ᶜ <he>משש שעות ולמעלן</he> after six hours (noon); <he>משש שעות ולמען</he> before noon.
<cite ref="Yoma 21b:8">Yoma 21ᵇ</cite> <he>שש אשות הן</he> there are six kinds of fire.
<cite ref="Pesachim 49b:12">Pes. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ דברים נאמרו וכ׳</he> six things have been said concerning ignorant people; a. v. fr.—Constr. m. <cite ref="U02066"><he>שֵׁשֶׁת</he></cite>.
Snh. 97ᵃ; Ab. Zar. 9ᵃ; v. שָׁנָה II; a. fr.—Pl. שִׁשִּׁים sixty.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 58b:8">B. Kam. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>סאה בש׳ סאין</he> the damage to a field of one S’ah is assessed by calculation from a field of sixty S’ahs (so as to arrive at a fair estimate).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 58b">Ib.</cite> <he>בש׳</he> taking as a basis for calculation sixty times the quantity under dispute; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 59a">ib. 59ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chullin 97b">Ḥull. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>בש׳</he> (sub. <cite ref="B00515"><he>בטל</he></cite>) is neutralized in a quantity sixty times as large.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:24">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>ש׳ בכרס אחד</he> sixty at one birth.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:2">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᶜ</cite> top <he>ש׳ רבוא</he> sixty myriads.
